# Where to Watch Go West


by Angel | August 20, 2026


The Oregon Trail was never supposed to be easy. But when two sisters set out for Oregon with a wildly mismatched group of travelers, the journey becomes a whole lot more unpredictable—and a whole lot funnier. With harsh winters, endless miles, and plenty of personality clashes along the way, getting to the other side will take more than a sturdy handcart.


[Watch Season 1 of Go West now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/go-west)


### **Thousands of Miles From Home**


The road from Illinois to Oregon is long, unpredictable, and filled with challenges. Every new obstacle gives the travelers another reason to panic, argue, improvise, or completely lose the plot.


But beneath all the absurdity, there’s something surprisingly relatable about the group. They may not always agree, and they certainly don’t always know what they’re doing, but they’re in this together.


Little by little, the journey forces them to find common ground and discover that getting to their new home will require more than individual determination.


### **A Wild Ride From the Original Studio C Cast**


Fans of the original *Studio C* cast will recognize the same offbeat humor and unmistakable comedic chemistry that made them fan favorites.


*Go West* takes the hardships of pioneer life and turns them into an unpredictable family comedy packed with eccentric characters, ridiculous situations, and plenty of laughs. One viewer even described it as “a Monty Python take on the Oregon Trail.”


Whether you’re already a *Studio C* fan or simply looking for something funny to watch together, the series brings a fresh spin to a familiar chapter of American history.


### **A Comedy About Finding Common Ground**


For all its chaos, *Go West* has a simple heart at its center: sometimes the people you end up with aren’t the people you would have chosen, but they’re the people you need.


The travelers may spend plenty of time getting on each other’s nerves, but their journey also brings them closer together. After all, when you’ve got thousands of miles between you and home, there’s no better time to learn how to laugh together.


### **Stream** ***Go West*** **on Angel**


Pack your handcart, gather the family, and get ready for a very different trip along the Oregon Trail. With big personalities, absurd adventures, and plenty of laughs, *Go West* turns a long journey west into a comedy worth taking.


[Watch Season 1 of Go West today on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/go-west)
